  Job type:  Full time 

  Salary offer:  Up to $120k + super + bonus + KM's + PD allowance 

  Location:  Sydney 

   

  About the company:  

 Our client is a leading Allied Health provider with over 20 years of excellence in delivering high-quality, evidence-based care. With 13 clinics across NSW and Tasmania and a team of more than 200 professionals, they are recognised for their collaborative culture, innovative approach, and commitment to helping both clients and clinicians reach their full potential. 

 They offer industry-leading career pathways, strong professional development support, and a dynamic, multi-disciplinary environment where excellence thrives. 

   

  About the role:   

 This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated Podiatrist to join a supportive and high-performing team in Sydney. Working as a contractor, you will deliver high-quality podiatry services across clinic and community settings. 

 Your daily responsibilities may include: 

 
	 General Foot Care 
	 Diabetic Foot Care 
	 Nail Surgery 
	 Musculoskeletal & Biomechanics Assessment 
	 Custom Orthotics 
	 Paediatric Podiatry 
	 NDIS Client Support 
 

   

 Benefits & What’s on Offer 

 
	 ??  Competitive Package  – Up to $120k + super, bonuses, KM reimbursement, and PD allowance 
	 ??  State-of-the-Art Facilities  – Clinics equipped with gyms, sensory rooms, motor development spaces, and advanced technology 
	 ??  Collaborative Culture  – Work within a supportive, multi-disciplinary team across seven allied health disciplines 
	 ??  Career Progression  – Structured pathways into specialisation, leadership, management, or ownership 
	 ??  Professional Development  – Weekly PD sessions and access to an extensive learning library 
	 ??  Meaningful Work  – Make a genuine impact through tailored, evidence-based care in clinic and community settings 
 

   

 Requirements 

 To be successful in this role, you will have: 

 
	 A recognised qualification in Podiatry 
	 Current AHPRA registration 
	 Strong clinical skills across general and complex podiatry cases 
	 Experience working with NDIS clients (highly regarded) 
	 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
	 Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team 
	 Willingness to travel regionally as required 
	 Full Australian working rights

ICT Business Analysts 
Looking for a software Business Analyst to join software development team. •	Develops templates to accurately and concisely write requirements specifications

result.description:
## Cyber Security Engineer
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Cyber Security Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in safeguarding our software systems, applications, and digital infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining robust security solutions that are fully integrated into our development and operational environments. This role suits a technically adept professional with a strong background in secure software development, vulnerability management, and security architecture who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced setting.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement cyber security software applications and systems, ensuring they are fully integrated, well-documented, and aligned with organisational security standards
- Develop and enforce secure coding practices across the software development lifecycle, embedding security controls at every stage from design through to deployment
- Conduct comprehensive security testing, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing on software, systems, and infrastructure to identify and address potential risks
- Collaborate closely with software developers and engineering teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities and coding weaknesses in a timely manner
- Participate in code reviews, offering expert security guidance and ensuring that development teams adhere to established security frameworks and best practices
- Design and maintain secure application programming interfaces (APIs) and libraries for use across software and application environments
- Assess the security posture of third-party software components, open-source libraries, and vendor integrations, providing recommendations to mitigate associated risks
- Perform binary and static code analysis scans on software applications to detect vulnerabilities before release into production environments
- Monitor, analyse, and respond to security incidents and threats across the organisation's systems, networks, and applications
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve security policies, standards, and documentation to reflect evolving threat landscapes and regulatory requirements
- Support the integration of security tooling and automation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous security testing and compliance validation
- Liaise with internal stakeholders, including IT, compliance, and senior leadership, to provide clear reporting on security risks, incidents, and remediation progress
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security engineering or information security role, ideally within a complex enterprise environment
- Strong proficiency in secure software development practices and knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 and CVSS
- Hands-on experience conducting vulnerability assessments, security testing, and code analysis using industry-standard tools
- Solid understanding of network security, identity and access management, encryption protocols, and security architecture principles
- Experience integrating security controls into DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines
- Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, PowerShell, or Bash
- Familiarity with cloud security concepts and platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex security risks and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent
- Experience working within regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government
- Familiarity with Australian Privacy Act requirements, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Exposure to threat modelling methodologies and security risk management frameworks
- Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation that places cyber security at the heart of its technology strategy, giving you genuine influence over how security is designed and delivered
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible, hybrid working arrangement that supports a healthy work-life balance
- Work within a collaborative and inclusive team culture that values innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
- Competitive remuneration package with clear pathways for career progression into senior and leadership roles
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description: SHELFORD CONSTRUCTIONS PTY LTD   About the Role   We are seeking an experienced  Software Engineer  to join our team in East Rockingham, Western Australia.  The successful applicant will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing and maintaining software applications that support the company's construction and business operations. The position involves developing innovative software solutions, enhancing existing applications and working closely with internal stakeholders to improve business processes through technology.      Benefits  Salary plus superannuation    Task & responsibilities   Key Duties and Responsibilities    Analyse user requirements and business processes to determine software specifications and system requirements.  Design, develop, test and implement software applications and business systems.  Develop and maintain web-based applications using modern software development frameworks.  Modify, enhance and support existing software applications.  Migrate legacy Microsoft Access applications to modern web-based platforms.  Integrate software applications with third-party proprietary systems and business platforms.  Develop database structures and optimise application performance.  Prepare and maintain technical documentation, software specifications and user procedures.  Troubleshoot software issues and provide ongoing maintenance and technical support.  Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for system improvements and automation.  Participate in software testing, deployment and continuous improvement activities.  Ensure software solutions comply with organisational standards, security requirements and industry best practice.    Qualification & experience   Skills and Experience    Relevant qualifications and experience aligned with  ANZSCO 331212 Carpenter .  AQF Certificate III including at least two years of relevant on-the-job training;  or   AQF Certificate IV in Carpentry or a closely related trade discipline.  At least  three (3) years of relevant industry experience  may substitute for formal qualifications.  Demonstrated experience in residential, commercial or industrial carpentry.  Ability to interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications.  Sound knowledge of construction methods, building materials and safe work practices.  Strong commitment to workplace health and safety.       Selection Criteria:     Relevant tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline.  Minimum of  two (2) years' full-time experience  in a Software Engineer or closely related role.  Demonstrated ability to design, develop, test and maintain enterprise software applications.  Experience working with modern software development technologies and frameworks.  Ability to analyse complex business requirements and develop practical software solutions.  Strong documentation, organisational and stakeholder engagement skills.  Ability to work in a collaborative environment while managing competing priorities.  Commitment to continuous improvement and high-quality software development practices.    How to Apply   Please click  "Apply Now"  and submit your resume outlining your relevant qualifications and professional experience.  All applications will be treated confidentially.  Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.  About Company     Shelford Constructions Pty Ltd is a well-established Western Australian construction company specialising in residential and commercial construction projects throughout the Perth metropolitan area and regional Western Australia.    With over 30 years of industry experience, Shelford Constructions is committed to delivering high-quality construction services through innovation, operational excellence and continuous investment in technology. The company develops and maintains integrated software solutions that support its business operations, project delivery and internal management systems.
